messages:
olivia: FYI NovusWell sent an RFI. They want a capability matrix, short POC ops plan, deployment mapping (hosted/dedicated/private), and a 3-month pricing estimate for ~80M tokens/month + 5k embeddings. 48h turnaround. Who can pick up which parts?

hank: I can handle the capability matrix. Procurement asks explicit rows for quantization, batching, KV cache, model fallback, and SSO/KMS.

maya: I'll draft the POC ops plan and the deployment table. Will include a canary snippet and rollback thresholds. Also note BYOK/KMS options and audit log retention.

olivia: Good. They also asked whether we can run the POC inside their AWS account and if we ship model weights. Please be explicit.

hank: Short answers: we don't hand over Redwood-managed model weights; open-source catalog models can be provided per license. POC-in-customer-AWS: Hosted=no, Dedicated=possible with VPC peering/reserved nodes, Private=yes (VPC or on-prem). I'll include a table.

maya: Ops snippet to include in the runbook:
```
route: novuswell-poc
model: redwood-7b-quant
canary: {pct:5, window:24h}
rollback: latency>1.5s || errors>1%
```

secbot: (uploaded) novuswell_rfi_assets_v1.zip - cap_matrix.xlsx, rfi_answers.md, poc_runbook.md, pricing_estimates.csv

olivia: Finance is needed to confirm the POC discount. I'll ping them. Target to send the bundle by 09:00 PT tomorrow.

hank: I'll export the matrix PDF and add a perf one-pager for 2k context / 512 gen latency numbers.

maya: I'll finalize the deployment note and attach explicit sentence: "Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and optional HSM integration."

olivia: Thanks. Once finance confirms pricing and legal signs the RFI text we can send. Marking thread in follow-up. :thumbsup:
